brief:
Israeli settlers smashed cars and hurled rocks at Palestinian residents of al-Mughayyir village in the occupied West Bank while Israeli forces looked on, Middle East Eye reported. A video shared by Palestinians documented the incident, which also included damage to an ambulance in the village.

The report did not specify when the attack occurred or provide details on injuries or the extent of damage to the vehicles.
